themeSwitcher.description: A different atmosphere. The same Cosmic Signature.
themeSwitcher.sitewide: Your choice follows you across the site.

attention.title: Alerts and sound
attention.intro: Everything here stays off until you turn it on. Choices are saved in this browser.

sound.label: Chime when a Gesture follows yours
sound.description: A short sound when another participant’s Gesture follows your latest one. Needs a connected wallet and this tab open.

alert.label: Alert before finalization
alert.description: A browser notification before the Cycle Finalization Time. Keep this tab open.
alert.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings to use this alert.
alert.unsupported: This browser does not show notifications.

tabTitle.label: Countdown in the tab title
tabTitle.description: Shows the time left in the browser tab during the final hour of a cycle.
